node_definition.done_when: Done when a new tests/test_a_re_review_reads_what_changed.py shows, with a temporary repository holding a run reviewed once and repaired by two commits: the composed re-review brief names the previously reviewed head, exactly those two commits, and the earlier review's findings with their dispositions; and a first review's brief names none of these. Negative control: composing the re-review as a first review drops the previous head from the brief. The test files importing the brief composer add no failure against the base revision, measured on all_debug , one arm at a time with at most -n 4 . Ruff check and ruff format --check add no findings on the staged paths. Write paths: the review brief composer module (named in the manifest) and the new test.
